rv.q: Christopher Purves’ brutish Scarpia, however, is terrific F our years since English National Opera unveiled its previous Tosca (a hyper-stylised affair directed by Christof Loy), the curtain goes up on another new production, this time by ENO’s artistic director Annilese Miskimmon .
For those who like full-throated, unapologetically dramatic singing, this is a dream cast for you.
